sentence: This project studies how extracellular vesicles are linked to kidney damage in preeclampsia, using a mouse model and a human kidney-on-a-chip model.
This project gathers evidence on whether behavior change interventions can reduce health risks from air pollution.
This project studies how acute cannabis use and withdrawal affect depression and suicidal ideation among adolescents, using ecological momentary assessment.
This project uses model organisms such as the fruit fly and laboratory mouse to help interpret variants of uncertain significance in rare genetic disorders.
This project studies how the host response and mitochondria work, using an evolutionary framework.
This project builds stem cells with genetic edits so that donor cells can be given for therapy without immunosuppressive drugs.
This project tries to understand stroke patients who do poorly after endovascular stroke therapy, and builds machine learning models to predict who they are.
This project tests in mice whether B cells reprogrammed with CRISPR can make lasting antibodies against HIV.
This project builds a tool that maps the RNA and proteins found at synapses in the mammalian brain.
This project sets up a system that measures many metabolites at once to help study metabolic processes linked to disease.
This project carries out basic, translational and patient-oriented cancer research together.
This project tries to find out how caloric restriction improves immunological memory, to help design more effective vaccination strategies.
This project builds an imaging tool that uses Raman imaging to study immune cells in human brain tissue in Alzheimer’s disease.
This project tries to find out how the uterus contracts after delivery and what goes wrong in uterine atony.
This project uses synthetic chemistry to build MRI and fluorescent probes on nanoparticles made from fullerene.
This project builds a way to attach extracellular vesicles to a biomaterial for tissue repair and regeneration.
This project tries to find personalized ways to manage blood pressure in patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.
This project studies how a G protein subunit called beta 2 helps macrophages control infection by Legionella bacteria.
